g.text: 温馨提示 - 站点类型
单线车站 - 无可换乘线路的车站
Non-transfer station - Station with no connecting lines
换乘车站 - 有可换乘线路的车站
Transfer Station - Station with connecting lines
出站换乘车站 - 无费区内换乘的车站
Transfer Station (exiting the station) - Station for
transfers out of the pay area
虚线 (转乘) - 两处站点或线路间没有换乘，
但是有较短的步行路径连接进行转乘
Dotted line (informal transfer) - No formal transfer exists
between two stations or lines, but a short walking route
